reviewSamples.author: Photo of Crystal_HairSlayer
reviewSamples.text: LOVE THIS PLACE!!!! They make cakes, & have some ready to take! You can buy packaged treats or homemade treats and the bakery display was phenomenal!!!!!! Wish I lived closer! My dogs loved all the treats they have had, now it will be a required stop every time we are in Tallahassee!!
